Re cutting Tehran’s electricity (which is collective punishment and considered a war crime): From what I heard, the theory being entertained is that if the capital loses power, Iranians will rise up and pressure the regime into making a deal—assuming they survive the uprising.

One of the Iranians in Tehran I spoke with couldn’t understand why the US and Israel would want to target the country’s energy infrastructure instead of its leadership.

“We’ll fall behind 30–40 years,” they told me, if Tehran’s electricity is struck.
